text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho. In the stands, 
fervent anticipation swirled for Mihono 
Bourbon, who had overcome the barrier of 
her distance aptitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower tremblingly offers a handshake 
to her idol. Without understanding why, 
Mihono Bourbon politely shakes back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, —the Satsuki Sho begins right now!
